The '''ILF-6500 Life Form Scanner''' was a specialized scanner produced by [[Idellian Arrays]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that was tuned to locate and identify life forms. The device could hold data on twenty species at a time and would automatically categorize them according to the threat.<ref name="ETU" />
